scripts.build: npm run validate:package && npm run build --workspace @copc-test/vanilla && npm run build --workspace @copc-test/react && npm run build --workspace @copc-test/next
scripts.typecheck: npm run validate:package && npm run typecheck --workspace @copc-test/vanilla && npm run typecheck --workspace @copc-test/react && npm run typecheck --workspace @copc-test/next
scripts.test:shared: npm run test --workspace @copc-test/core && npm run test --workspace @copc-test/fixture-server
scripts.test: npm run test:package && npm run test:shared
scripts.test:fast: npm run test && npm run fixtures:fetch -- small-valid-copc && npm run build && npm run e2e:fast
scripts.test:full: npm run test && npm run fixtures:fetch -- small-valid-copc && npm run build && npm run e2e:full
scripts.test:local: npm run bootstrap:local && npm run test:fast
scripts.test:tarball: npm run bootstrap:tarball && npm run test:fast
